svg.title: UNICA — a merchant's till becomes a portfolio, and the portfolio still spends
svg.desc: Social card, dark. Wordmark UNICA, the brand line, and two status rows: exact settlement through Uniswap v4 is live on Ethereum Sepolia; treasury automation and confidential execution are being built. Built by NFTeria, independent.
